label: Dynamic Viewpoint
description: Energetic and unusual camera positions for any subject.

items.name: drone-high
items.text: high drone shot looking steeply down, subject small in a vast environment

items.name: birds-eye-topdown
items.text: perfect top-down bird's-eye view, the scene flattened into graphic shapes

items.name: worms-eye
items.text: extreme worm's-eye view from ground level, subject towering against the sky

items.name: dutch-tilt
items.text: dutch tilt, the horizon canted for restless tension

items.name: pov-hands
items.text: first-person point of view, the viewer's own hands entering the frame

items.name: isometric
items.text: clean isometric three-quarter overhead perspective, diorama-like parallel projection

items.name: through-foreground
items.text: shot through out-of-focus foreground elements, layered voyeuristic depth

items.name: reflection-only
items.text: the subject seen only as a reflection, in glass, water or chrome

items.name: tracking-side
items.text: side-on tracking view moving with the subject, background streaking past

items.name: macro-distance
items.text: macro-range closeness, shallow focus, textures becoming landscapes
